recognize_zh: 脾臟觸摸抹片中以小至中型淋巴球為主，核圓、染色質中度凝集、少數有小核仁，並有一圈中等量淡藍色細胞質（比 CLL 細胞多），箭頭處為一個染色質呈碎塊狀的細胞（疑似分裂像），符合脾邊緣區淋巴瘤。
features: Monotonous small-to-medium lymphoid cells, larger than typical CLL cells
Round to slightly irregular nuclei with moderately condensed chromatin; occasional small nucleoli
Moderate amounts of pale blue cytoplasm; distinct villous projections not evident in this field
Arrow marks a cell with clumped, fragmented chromatin, possibly a mitotic figure
Paucity of other cell types, indicating effacement by the lymphoid population
describe_en: Touch preparation of spleen shows a monotonous population of small-to-medium lymphoid cells with round to slightly irregular nuclei, moderately condensed chromatin, occasional small nucleoli and a moderate rim of pale basophilic cytoplasm. A cell with clumped, fragmented chromatin, possibly a mitotic figure, is indicated by the arrow. Large transformed cells are not a dominant component, and polar villous projections are not convincingly seen at this magnification. Findings are consistent with a low-grade B-cell lymphoma and, in context, compatible with splenic marginal zone lymphoma.

ddx.vs: CLL cells are smaller with scant cytoplasm and coarse block-like chromatin and are CD5/CD23 positive.
Hairy cells have oval or bean-shaped nuclei with abundant pale cytoplasm and circumferential hairy projections and are CD103, CD25, CD11c and annexin A1 positive.
Mantle cell lymphoma cells have scant cytoplasm and notched nuclei and are CD5 and cyclin D1 positive.
